title: Hot-fix: compose fixture makes every candidate distinct; the composed-tree gate runs its own tests at depth 1
objective: Make main green again and close the gate's blind spot on itself: candidates differ from base by construction, and the composed run exercises the compose tests (depth 1), refusing only at depth 2.
business_value: A gate that skips its own tests inside the composed world cannot protect the merge that ships it. Twice now a fixture assumed something about origin/main that the merge changed.
in_scope: this branch's own composed run as the regression proof
acceptance_criteria: compose tests pass when the working tree equals origin/main (the composed run of this branch proves it: HEAD == origin/main there)
depth-2 nesting is refused; depth-1 runs the compose tests inside the composed suite
push-to-main run for the squash is green
permissions: write: scratch clones under tmp only
evidence: composed run output for this branch

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
